_comment: Minimal IAM policy for an OpenBao instance using seal "awskms".
Three actions, no more. Encrypt and Decrypt wrap and unwrap the root key.
DescribeKey is called at startup, before any encryption happens, to fetch
the key's metadata: with it missing you get 'error fetching AWS KMS
wrapping key information' and the process exits while configuring the seal.
and anything with a wildcard action. OpenBao does not create the key and must
not be able to destroy the one thing that can open its own barrier.
Replace REGION, ACCOUNT_ID and KEY_ID. Scope Resource to the single key ARN,
never "*": a wildcard here grants the instance use of every KMS key in the
This file cannot be validated in the MiniStack lab, because the emulator does
not enforce IAM at all. It is correct per the OpenBao documentation and is the
part of this lesson you must verify against real AWS yourself.
